title: Preflight pipeline: modular preflight checks, OPA intent policies, and staged plan evidence for VPC rollouts
creator: Jordan Patel
description:
Summary:
This ticket scopes and implements a modular preflight pipeline for Private/VPC Terraform deployments. The goal is to run deterministic, reproducible checks before apply that combine (1) linting and static IaC checks, (2) OPA/Rego intent policies that validate high-level intent (eg. no public subnets opened, KMS keys not removed), and (3) a plan-evidence aggregator that captures plan diffs, resource change graph, and policy evaluation artifacts for auditing and rollback decisions.

Why now:
- Recent Private pilot customers requested stronger pre-apply guarantees and auditable evidence for security/compliance reviews.
- Existing plan gates are scattered: Conftest/OPA checks run but lack standardized evidence export and intent-level rules.
- We need a single pluggable pipeline that teams can opt into for Dedicated/Private installs and that integrates with our Console rollouts and alerting.

Deliverables:
- A GitHub Actions + internal runner workflow (patternable to GitLab) that performs: terraform fmt + tflint, targeted tfsec/Checkov scans, terraform plan with automated state selection, run OPA/Rego policies against both HCL JSON and plan JSON, and produce a plan-evidence bundle (signed JSON + attachments).
- Conftest/OPA policy library with intent-level rules (public ip exposure, cross-account peering, kms key policy shrinking) and a small set of canonical regression tests.
- Evidence storage schema and upload mechanism (S3 compatible + metadata) used by Console to show preflight artifacts per PR/Deploy.
- A policy-scoring adapter that converts multiple policy outcomes into a single pass/warn/fail score and recommendations.
- E2E test matrix and rollout playbook for enabling pipeline on customer VPC modules.

Acceptance criteria:
- PR workflow blocks merge when policies return fail-level findings; warnings allowed but surfaced.
- Each blocked plan includes a link to a plan-evidence bundle in the Console and a signed policy evaluation report.
- Teams can opt-in per-repo via a config (preflight.yaml) to select rulesets, thresholds, and evidence retention.
- Metrics emitted: preflight pass rate, false-positive rate (tracked via manual overrides), time-to-fix after preflight failure.

Scope decisions and trade-offs:
- We will support both Conftest (rego) and a narrow set of native checks (tflint/tfsec). Full Checkov support deferred to future ticket to avoid duplication.
- Plan-evidence bundles will prioritize small attachments and JSON references to state diffs to keep storage costs bounded. Full binary blobs (eg. full state copies) are out-of-scope for now.
- We favor GitHub Actions for initial rollout; will provide a runner-compatible manifest for self-hosted CI in private deployments.

Implementation notes:
- Terraform version: 1.5+ (ensure plan JSON compatibility); support Terragrunt via wrapper script.
- Policy engine: OPA/Rego + Conftest harness. Create a small policy framework repo: infra-policy-library.
- Evidence storage: use existing S3-backed artifact store (bucket: redwood-infra-preflight) with per-team prefixes and server-side encryption via KMS.
- Sign evidence bundles with service key stored in Vault; include signature in metadata for audit.
- Integrations: Console UI will ingest evidence links; Console team ticket: PM-512 to add UI card.

Risks and mitigation:
- High false-positive risk for aggressive rules -> include a "dry-run/learning" mode and feedback loop to classify findings.
- Performance: running many linters slows CI -> parallelize steps and allow selective rules via config.
- Secret exposure in plan output -> implement redaction rules before storing evidence bundle.

Next steps / immediate tasks:
1) Define preflight.yaml schema and defaults (owner: Aisha).
2) Prototype GH Action workflow + Conftest run against a sample VPC module (owner: Jordan).
3) Draft minimal Rego rules for public-ip and kms-key-change intent (owner: Max Chen).
4) Create evidence bundle schema and upload path (owner: SRE infra).

Links:
- Design doc: https://confluence.internal/redwood/private-preflight-pipeline
- Prototype PR: https://github.com/redwood-infra/preflight-prototype/pull/7
comments: 2025-11-06 - Jordan Patel: Kickoff: scoped initial prototype. Will use GitHub Actions + self-hosted runner manifest for private installs. Decided to require terraform >=1.5 to use improved plan JSON output.

2025-11-09 - Aisha Gomez: Design review notes posted on Confluence; requested explicit redaction rules for secrets and an opt-in flag for retention >30 days. Assigned SRE to define KMS wrapping for evidence buckets.

2025-11-11 - Max Chen: Added initial Rego rules for 'no public subnet attachment' and 'kms key removal'. Tests in /policy-tests cover positive/negative cases. Observed a false positive with provider-generated public IPs; plan to add exception pattern.

2025-11-13 - PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-infra/preflight-prototype/pull/7. The workflow runs: fmt -> tflint -> plan -> conftest. Current blocker: plan JSON schema mismatch when using terragrunt wrapper.

2025-11-15 - QA: End-to-end run against sample-vpc repository succeeded; evidence bundle uploaded to s3://redwood-infra-preflight/sample-team/ENG-377215/plan-20251115.json.sig. Manual review confirmed redaction applied to sensitive outputs.

2025-11-18 - Aisha Gomez: Updated ticket with decision to surface a 'policy score' (0-100) in Console. Also requested metrics hooks: 'preflight.run.duration', 'preflight.policy.failures' and 'preflight.evidence.upload.size'. Scheduled rollout checkpoint on 2025-11-24.
Blockers: Need final SRE approval for KMS key rotation policy (tracked in ENG-50234). Also need a short DX guide for customers to opt into preflight.yaml (PM will draft).
